newsitem.title: UK: EC launches inquiry into BA /American link.
newsitem.headline: EC launches inquiry into BA /American link.

text.p: The European Commission has launched a formal inquiry into the planned link-up between British Airways and American Airlines, said the Times newspaper.
The commission has written to the airlines saying that the proposed alliance does not appear to be in the interests of consumers and they have 60 days in which to respond, said the paper.

Commentators suggested that Ian Lang, president of the Board of Trade would be powerless to pass judgement on BA-AA while the EU was awaiting responses. But this was denied by the Department of Trade and Industry which said the move would have no bearing on the timing of any announcement, said the article.
Britain's Office of Fair Trading passed a report on the planned alliance to Lang in early October and he has since been considering whether to refer it to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
